{{Item|Bingo Artifact|amount=1}} }} The '''Bingo Relic''' is an {{Epic}} [[Accessory]], purchasable from {{NPCSprite|Bingo}}. == Obtaining == '''Bingo Relic''' can be purchased from {{BingoText|shop}} for {{Item|Bingo Artifact|amount=1}} and {{Bingo Points|200}} once the player has reached {{BingoText|4}}. '''Bingo Relic''' can also be obtained as a {{Red|'''MAJOR'''}} reward from [[Raffle of the Century]]. == Trivia == * Alongside {{Item|Hegemony Artifact}} and {{Item|Hocus-Pocus Cipher}} (outside of the rift) it does not grant any effects, which means it can only grant boosts through [[Accessory Powers]]. *The lore of the item is a reference to the children's song [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9mmF8zOlh_g BINGO], where the letters of the word are sung to spell out the name of a farmer's dog. **Furthermore, when playing the game Bingo, columns are often distinguished by those letters as opposed to A, B, C... == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2022/November 28|link=none|[[File:Bingo Relic.png|26px]] Added '''Bingo Relic'''.}} {{History|2022/December 1|link=none|'''Bingo Relic''' becomes obtainable.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Events/Bingo}} {{Nav/Accessories}}
